effects.affects: Nothing unless Clara applies a change from the panel.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the Clara panel appears.

effects.does: Opens the attachment control so the buyer can add files to the project.
effects.affects: Adds project attachment data for later submission.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments, select a file, and verify that the file is listed.

effects.does: Opens the terms and conditions editor.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and conditions drawer or dialog
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs, enter a clause, and verify that it remains in the editor.

effects.does: Does nothing because the Save as draft button is disabled.
effects.check: Verify that clicking Save as draft produces no request or navigation.

effects.does: Attempts to publish the event after running the project's validation checks.
effects.affects: If validation succeeds, creates or activates the event and stores its project and stage data.
effects.leadsTo: Published event or a validation error on this screen
effects.check: Click Publish without a title or required BOQ data and verify that publication is blocked with an error.

effects.does: Sets the auction to rank bids on lots.
effects.affects: Changes the auction closing mode to lot-based ranking.
effects.check: Click Rank on lot and verify that the lot-based ranking option is selected.

effects.affects: Nothing because template selection is currently blocked.
effects.check: Verify that Select Templates cannot be activated in the current incomplete state.

effects.affects: Changes the event's audience_company_uuids participant list.
effects.check: Open Participants, add a vendor, and verify that the vendor appears in the participant list.

effects.does: Does nothing because Savings is disabled.
effects.check: Verify that clicking Savings does not open savings configuration while the required template and product are missing.

effects.does: Does nothing because Terms & Conditions is disabled.
effects.check: Verify that clicking Terms & Conditions does not open its editor while the required template and product are missing.

effects.does: Does nothing because the schedule control is disabled.
effects.check: Verify that clicking the disabled schedule control does not open scheduling options.

effects.does: Keeps the event in Auction mode.
effects.affects: Sets the event mode used for auction configuration and validation.
effects.check: Verify that Auction remains highlighted and auction-specific controls are shown.

effects.does: Navigates back to the Events area.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the events list loads.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Sets or edits the project title.
effects.affects: Changes the title field sent in the project payload and used during publication.
effects.check: Enter a title and verify that the value remains populated before publishing.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Does nothing because the vendor selector is disabled.
effects.check: Verify that clicking the disabled vendor selector does not open vendor search or add a participant.

cases.title: Publish is blocked when no template or BOQ sheet is provided
cases.expected: The event is not published. The screen shows "Please choose a template and upload a BOQ sheet to proceed". "Select Templates" remains disabled until the screen permits template selection, and "Add Attachments" is available for uploading the BOQ sheet.
cases.setup: Open /orders/quick-create with no template and no BOQ sheet.

cases.title: Add Attachments opens the BOQ upload flow
cases.expected: An attachment or file-upload interface opens, allowing the tester to choose a BOQ sheet. The create screen remains available after closing the interface.
cases.setup: Open /orders/quick-create without an uploaded BOQ sheet.
gaps: Confirm that the uploaded file is specifically recognized as a BOQ sheet

cases.title: Add T&Cs opens terms and conditions editing
cases.expected: A terms and conditions editor or picker opens. After closing it without saving, "Terms & Conditions" remains disabled. After adding terms and returning to the screen, the terms configuration is available from the create screen.
cases.setup: Open /orders/quick-create with no terms and conditions configured.
gaps: Entering or selecting terms and conditions in the editor or picker
Saving terms and returning to the create screen
Asserting that the Terms & Conditions configuration becomes enabled after saved terms are added

cases.title: Verify blocked setup controls explain the missing BOQ data
steps: Observe the message near the project setup area.
cases.expected: The message says "Please choose a template and upload a BOQ sheet to proceed". Save as draft and Select Templates are disabled.
cases.setup: Open /orders/quick-create with the screen in its current state.

cases.title: Open Clara from the create screen
cases.expected: The Clara assistance panel or dialog opens.
gaps: The catalog has no dedicated step to verify the Clara panel or drawer specifically; unconfirmed accessible name: Clara

cases.title: Return to the events area
cases.expected: The events area opens and the create screen is no longer displayed.
